sections.content: Use *todavía* no with the pretérito perfecto to say that something has not happened yet. Todavía no goes before the auxiliary: Todavía no he *visto* el *templo*. The action is expected or possible later, but it has not happened up to now.

items.spanish: Todavía no he visto el templo.
items.english: I have not seen the temple yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos recorrido el camino.
items.english: We have not travelled along the path yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no han visitado el arrozal.
items.english: They have not visited the rice field yet.
I have not taken photographs yet.

sections.content: Do not remove the no: *todavía* no means 'not yet'. Todavía by itself has a different use.
